title: Portable Digital Luggage Scale With Retractable Hook, High-Precision Travel Suitcase Weight Scale With LCD Display, White
body_html:
[High-Precision & Heavy-Duty Capacity] Engineered with an advanced sensory system, this electronic luggage scale delivers pinpoint measurements with an ultra-fine 0.01 lbs. (5g) graduation. It handles a wide weighing range from 0.04 lbs. up to 66 lbs. (20g - 30kg), making it an indispensable tool for everything from compact carry-ons to heavy check-in suitcases.

[Retractable Hook & Space-Saving Design] Featuring an innovative, integrated design, the durable stainless steel hanging hook smoothly folds back into a customized slot on the rear of the scale when not in use. This clever structure prevents scratches on other items in your bag and ensures a sleek, tangle-free profile during transit.

[Crystal-Clear LCD Display & Touch Controls] Equipped with a generous 1.87" x 1.04" (47.5 x 26.4 mm) digital display, weight values are clearly legible from any angle. The sensitive, ergonomic single-button control allows you to power on the device, activate the convenient Tare/Zero function, and instantly toggle between g, lbs., and kg units.

[Smart Auto-Off & Eco-Friendly Battery Life] Powered by a single, widely available CR2032 button cell battery (included), this travel accessory utilizes a smart power-saving chip. The device features an automatic shut-off mechanism after periods of inactivity, preventing unnecessary battery drainage and ensuring it is always ready for your next departure.

[Pocket-Sized Portability for Jetsetters] Measuring just 5.9" x 1.67" x 0.98" (150 x 42.5 x 25 mm), this lightweight, streamlined handheld scale slips effortlessly into your pocket, backpack, or side luggage compartment. Bring it along on your travels to weigh bags before return flights, confidently avoiding unexpected and costly airline overweight baggage fees.
